Concept Description: Highest level of formal education the participant has completed. BDC-HM: SdohObservation with observation_type EDUCATIONAL_ATTAINMENT (meaning OMOP:4022643 'Educational achievement') and value_enum from EducationalAttainmentObservationTypeEnum. Use for highest grade or degree completed, or years of schooling (binned). Not for a parent's or spouse's education, or for current school enrollment.

Concept Description: Total income of the participant's family or household over a stated period (usually the past 12 months, before taxes), usually reported in cohort-specific brackets. BDC-HM: SdohObservation with observation_type FAMILY_INCOME (meaning OMOP:4076114 'Household income'); household-income items map here too. Use for family or household income totals and yes/no income-threshold questions. Not for financial-strain items (e.g. difficulty paying bills) or poverty-to-income ratios. Brackets are written as text in Quantity.value_concept (BDC-HM has no income-bracket enum); exact amounts go in Quantity.value_decimal; unit {USD} either way.
other units and conversion: Production gold writes unit 'USD', which is not valid UCUM; '{USD}' is the same unit as a valid UCUM annotation, so no value changes scale. Amounts are nominal dollars of the survey year: do not inflation-adjust or re-bin across cohorts.

Concept Description: The type of work the participant does or did to earn money (current, most recent, usual or longest-held). BDC-HM: SdohObservation with observation_type OCCUPATION (meaning OMOP:36203487 'Occupation [Type]', LOINC 85658-3) and value_enum from OccupationTypeEnum (23 occupation groups whose names match the U.S. Standard Occupational Classification major groups, plus Unknown). Not for employment status (employed, unemployed, retired, homemaker, student), which has no BDC-HM value, and not for occupational exposures. V2 label: 'occupation'.
